staging_transaction_specification: Pin /, then home and root with descriptor-relative O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK opens. fstat UID0/GID0, record descriptor/path identities and revalidate them before/after each mutation. No permission repair.

Relative to the pinned /home/root descriptor, mkdirat only pi-ink-offline-reader-0029 with mode0700; fail if any object already occupies the name. Open it O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK and require exact UID0/GID0/mode0700 and matching descriptor/path identity. No recursive discovery.

Within that pinned directory open only reader using O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK|O_CLOEXEC with mode0500. Require regular file, UID0/GID0, nlink1 and exact mode0500. Transfer exactly2489186 binary bytes; detect any extra byte. Hash in process and require the frozen SHA256. Close the write descriptor before execution; reopen read-only with NOFOLLOW/NONBLOCK, verify size/hash/metadata and path/directory identity. Never chmod an existing object.

Record newly created helper and directory device/inode/metadata and hash as disposition pins. A staging failure does not authorize reuse, retry, overwrite or blanket removal. Preserve partial objects and report exact bounded failure for a new disposition decision.

A proven safe executor must verify those pins immediately before the single execution and retain helper descriptor identity through execution. A naked pathname invocation is not an adequate substitute for this missing executor prerequisite.
